v2.2.1

CI-only-fix patch, zero verdict impact: adds release evidence assets (rendered
per-policy bundle + SHA256SUMS, generated in the same signature-verifying CI
run -- ticket 14, real-estate epic) to the release workflow, and the handbook
generator's extraction into its own component (ticket 05, real-estate epic).
Neither touches workloads/kyverno/ or cloud/ -- every policy in this release
still declares itself version "2.2.0" internally (nameSuffix, cosmetic label,
matchConditions), exactly like v1.0.1/v2.0.1 before it: a release with zero
verdict impact is unversioned-in-substance even though it needed a new tag to
ship.
